title: ‘अँध्यारामा बाँच्नेहरू’ एकाङ्कीको समाजशास्त्रीय अध्ययन
nepali: लेखकले आफु बाँचेको युग र आफुले भोगेको सामाजिक, आर्थिक, भौगोलिक आदि पर्यावरणलाई दृष्टिगत गरी कृतिभित्रको समाजको वैज्ञानिक एवं वस्तुपरक ढङ्गले अध्ययन एवं विश्लेषण गर्ने सिद्धान्तलाई साहित्यको समाजशास्त्र भनिन्छ । अर्को शब्दमा साहित्यिक कृतिहरूमा अन्तर्निहित समाजको अध्ययन गर्ने एक विशिष्ट पद्धति वा सिद्धान्त हो साहित्यको समाजशास्त्र । साहित्यमा समाजकै चित्रण हुने हुँदा साहित्यिक कृतिका माध्यमबाट तत्कालीन समाजको अध्ययन गर्न सकिने कुरामा यस सिद्धान्तले विश्वास राख्दछ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनमा ‘अँध्यारामा बाँच्नेहरू’ एकाङ्कीको समाजशास्त्रीय अध्ययन गर्दा हिपोलाइट एडोल्फ टेनले अघि सारेको जाति, क्षण र पर्यावरणसम्बन्धी मान्यतालाई प्रमुख आधार बनाई उक्त मान्यता प्रस्तुत एकाङ्कीमा केकसरी प्रयोग भएको छ भन्ने जिज्ञासाको प्राज्ञिक समाधानका निम्ति एकाङ्कीमा प्रयुक्त विभिन्न पात्रहरूले बोलेका संवादहरूलाई साक्ष्यका रूपमा लिई वस्तुनिष्ठ ढङ्गले अध्ययन विश्लेषण गरिएको छ ।
american_english: The theory that studies and analyzes the society within a literary work in a scientific and objective manner, taking into consideration the era in which the author lived and the social, economic, geographical, and other environments they experienced, is called the sociology of literature. In other words, the sociology of literature is a specialized method or theory for studying the society inherent in literary works. Since society itself is depicted in literature, this theory holds the conviction that contemporary society can be studied through the medium of literary works. In the present study, while conducting a sociological study of the one-act play 'Andhyarama Banchneharu,' taking the concept concerning race, moment, and milieu advanced by Hippolyte Adolphe Taine as the primary basis, the dialogues spoken by various characters employed in the one-act play have been taken as evidence and objectively studied and analyzed for an academic resolution to the inquiry of how that concept has been utilized in the presented one-act play.

In other words, the sociology of literature is a distinct method or theory for studying the society inherent in literary works. As society itself is depicted in literature, this theory maintains that contemporary society can be studied through the medium of literary works. In the present study, when conducting a sociological study of the one-act play 'Andhyarama Banchneharu', taking the concept concerning race, moment and milieu put forward by Hippolyte Adolphe Taine as the primary foundation, the dialogues spoken by various characters employed in the one-act play have been taken as evidence and objectively studied and analysed for the scholarly resolution of the inquiry into how that concept has been applied in the presented one-act play.

informal_english: Ja, the theory that studies and analyses the society within a creative work in a scientific and objective manner, taking into consideration the era the author lived through and the social, economic, geographical and other environment they experienced, is called the sociology of literature. In other words, the sociology of literature is a proper distinct method or theory for studying the society inherent in literary works. Since literature mirrors society anyway, this theory reckons that contemporary society can be studied straight through the medium of literary works. In this present study, when doing a sociological study of the one-act play 'Andhyarama Banchneharu', taking the concept regarding race, moment and milieu put forward by Hippolyte Adolphe Taine as the main ground, the dialogues spoken by various characters used in the one-act play were taken as evidence and objectively studied and analysed to sort out the scholarly question of how that concept was actually applied in the play.
translator_notes: Hippolyte Adolphe Taine's classic triad of 'race, moment, and milieu' (जाति, क्षण र पर्यावरण) is preserved in technical critical terms. Title transliterated as 'Andhyarama Banchneharu' (Those Living in the Dark). Sentence boundaries and order preserved strictly.
